about.heroDesc: Sunshine Dermatology Clinic is a local practice led by a board-certified dermatologist with years of experience at university hospitals. We favor lasting beauty over trends, and healthy recovery over spectacle.
about.directorBio: Graduated from Keimyung University College of Medicine and completed residency at the National Medical Center. Served as director at Y&T Plastic Surgery in Apgujeong, A-Top Plastic Surgery, Prima Dermatology, and The One Clinic, building extensive clinical experience. Rather than following trends, we design a treatment plan that respects each patient's own tone and texture.

about.consultBody: Finished in marble and warm walnut, the consult room sets a calm tone for open dialogue. We take the time we need to understand your skin and your rhythm of life.
about.spaceDesc: From the waiting lounge to the powder room, every space is finished to hotel-grade quiet — comfortable, private, considered.

values.title: Honest Care
values.body: We don't recommend what you don't need. Minimum intervention, matched to your skin and life cycle, comes first.

values.title: A Considered Hand
values.body: Backed by 10+ years of clinical experience, we refine texture, tone, and line — one step at a time.

values.title: Premium Equipment
values.body: A curated set of top-tier high-end devices makes for quicker, more comfortable recovery.

about.equipmentDesc: Ulthera Prime, Thermage FLX, Shurink Universe, Clarity II, Starwalker, V-Beam, InMode, CarPri CO2 — a suite of top-tier devices, gathered in a single space.

lifting.label: Lifting
lifting.intro: A multi-layered approach to facial sagging and volume loss. Combinations and intensity are tailored to your skin and tissue condition.

process.title: Precise Consult
process.body: We design your combination from 3D facial analysis and a diagnosis of skin texture and volume.

process.title: Tailored Protocol
process.body: Ulthera, Shurink, thread lift and more — combined into a single session.

process.title: Recovery Care
process.body: Immediate post-treatment soothing and a home-care guide, together.

anti-aging.label: Anti-Aging
anti-aging.intro: We manage fine lines, volume, and texture as three connected axes — a care-first protocol that honors natural aging.

process.title: Aging Diagnosis
process.body: A precise reading of fine lines, volume, elasticity, and texture.

process.title: Layered Treatment
process.body: Toxins, fillers, and skin boosters — layered for a natural result.

process.title: Long-Term Plan
process.body: A care calendar built in 3–6 month intervals.

whitening.label: Whitening · Redness
whitening.intro: Pigmentation and redness, addressed from the root cause — with protocols adjusted for season and skin recovery.

process.title: Pigment Diagnosis
process.body: Accurate classification of epidermal, dermal, and vascular factors.

process.title: Targeted Treatment
process.body: Wavelength and intensity refined for each lesion.

process.title: Relapse Care
process.body: Sun protection and home care to minimize recurrence.

acne.label: Acne · Scars
acne.intro: An integrated protocol that reads the cause and stage of acne, then moves through soothing, regeneration, and scar care.

process.title: Stage Classification
process.body: Inflammatory, non-inflammatory, and scar stages — each approached differently.

process.title: Combined Care
process.body: Medication and procedures together, lowering recurrence.

process.title: Scar Recovery
process.body: Residual scars managed long-term with fractional and needle RF.

skin-disease.label: Skin Conditions
skin-disease.intro: As board-certified dermatologists, we provide evidence-based care from common conditions to chronic disease.

process.title: Accurate Diagnosis
process.body: KOH tests, biopsy, and more when necessary to identify the cause.

process.title: Evidence-Based Care
process.body: Topical, systemic, and procedural approaches, combined per guidelines.

process.title: Ongoing Follow-Up
process.body: Chronic conditions managed with long-term follow-up.
